findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed slight mold build-up on the gaskets of the make line prep cooler (lower doors). Maintain gaskets clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: There wasn't any soap available at the hand washing sink near the dish room. A new bag of soap was added to the soap dispenser to correct the violation. Ensure that there is always soap available at every handsink to be sure that hands are getting washed properly.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The chemical sanitizing dish machine was observed testing at 0ppm (CL). The machine was cycled and primed several times without a change in concentration. The facility was instructed to sanitize all dishes in triple sink until the dish machine can be serviced. Ensure that machine is serviced and sanitizing at the manufacturer’s recommended concentration. Will follow-up 6/15/2026.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A).

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: There were storage racks inside of the walk in cooler that contained a fuzzy debris on the outer surfaces. Shown to the PIC. Suggests that racks are taken outdoors to be power washed during down time. Ensure that racks are cleaned as frequently as necessary to prevent debris accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed there was not paper towels at the front hand washing sink (next to the custard preparation area) when the inspector arrived. Paper towels are required for the proper hand washing procedure. The PIC re-filled the paper towel dispenser during the inspection. Ensure that paper towels are always available at every hand washing sink.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed the can opener blade had a buildup of debris when the inspector arrived. The inspector explained that food can become contaminated when blades are soiled. The PIC removed the can opener to be washed, rinsed, and sanitized during the inspection. Ensure that the can opener is always sanitized after use.
findings.citation_text: 4-702.11 Before Use After Cleaning. UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be SANITIZED before use after cleaning.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed there is a building of debris around the soda nozzles of the customer service drink station (the soda nozzles are clean; the buildup is only in the surrounding area). Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of soil resides. Ensure that the area around the soda nozzles are clean to sight and touch by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed the floor underneath the custard preparation station and the drive through station have an accumulation of food, garbage, dirt, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of resides. Ensure that the floor underneath the custard station and drive through station are clean to sight and touch by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Observed the bottom of the prep cooler next to the dish machine was not holding temperature control for safety (TCS) foods at 41F or below. The ambient air temperature of the cooler was between 47F - 55F and the thermometer inside was reading about 48F. The foods inside the cooler were large containers of chicken strips, hot dogs, and chicken patties. The internal temperature of the chicken strips were 48F, hotdogs were 47F, and chicken patties were 50F. All of the foods had been inside the cooler since this morning. The foods were voluntarily discarded during the inspection. There were no other foods inside the prep cooler. For information about the cooler see violation #33.

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control
findings.comment:
Observed the bottom of the prep cooler next to the dish machine was not holding foods at 41F or below. There was not any foods held in the top of the prep cooler since it is known to be broken by the PIC. The PIC was not aware the bottom was also not functioning. The PIC stated that service was already in the process of being scheduled for the top of the prep cooler. Both the top and bottom will be serviced now. The inspector will return on 10/04/2024 to check on the temperature of the prep cooler. No TCS foods should be held inside the cooler until it is serviced and sufficient to cold hold foods at 41F or below. For information about the discarded foods see violation #22.

4-301.11: EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the fans in the walk-in cooler have an accumulation of dust. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of soil residues. Ensure the fans are cleaned by the next routine inspection. 

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed a mop being stored with the head in the mop sink basin. The mop was hung invented during the inspection. Ensure that mops are always stored in a position that allows the head to air dry.

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.
